summary.headline: Asgarnia core geography and League GWD/Troll route are sound; area list is thinner than Equilibrium's settlement list; content is mid-dense (15) with combat gaps; upgrade bag is very dense (122) and polluted by Stormguard-as-Asgarnia errors plus many cross-region dumps.
summary.leagueBoundaryNote: Base wiki places Death Plateau, Trollheim, Troll Stronghold and God Wars Dungeon in Troll Country (GWD infobox kingdom = Troll Country). Equilibrium League Areas/Asgarnia and project hardRules treat Burthorpe + northern troll approach + GWD as Asgarnia — KEEP that League override; do not invent a separate Troll Country elective region.
summary.densityNote: content.length=15 is denser than thin elective shells (e.g. Fremennik 3, Kandarin 5, Tirannwn 4) but still missing several Equilibrium combat rows. upgrades.length=122 is second-tier only to Misthalin-scale bags and includes many non-local rows.
summary.anchorsStatus: All 9 current catalog areas have placeAnchors; relative map-uv order matches Gielinor (Falador centre, Port Sarim south, Burthorpe/Death Plateau/Troll chain NW, GWD furthest north). New proposed areas need anchors before map ship.

issues.detail: Equilibrium League/Areas/Asgarnia notable settlements include Goblin Village, Ice Mountain, Rimmington, Entrana and The Arc — none appear in catalog areas. Skilling upgrades already treat Rimmington, Entrana, Ice Mountain/Camdozaal and Arc as Asgarnia, but areas[]/map pins do not.
evidence: catalog areas list omits those five names

issues.detail: Catalog uses Dwarven Mine; Equilibrium settlement list uses Ice Mountain. Both are correct Asgarnia geography (mines under Ice Mountain / Falador). Prefer keeping Dwarven Mine and adding Ice Mountain rather than renaming, so Camdozaal/Mind-Body altars and Mining Guild underground have a surface label.

hardRules correctly keep Burthorpe, Death Plateau, Trollheim, Troll Stronghold and GWD approach as Asgarnia. Base wiki Troll Country page must not become a selectable region. Catalog aliases (Trollheim, Troll Stronghold) support that.

Wiki Equilibrium League region badges on Stormguard Citadel Dig Site hotspots are Kandarin (Temple of Ikov surface entrance / dig-site taxonomy). Catalog Asgarnia upgrades hard-claim Stormguard/Howl workshop as Asgarnia geography for Ancient Invention blueprints, Divine Conversion, Inspire Genius, and ancient gizmo pressure. Armadyl's Tower (Lowse collector, Death Ward turn-in) is correctly Asgarnia (south of Falador). Split dig-site vs tower.
evidence: https://runescape.wiki/w/Stormguard_Citadel_Dig_Site (League region column = Kandarin on excavation rows)
catalog upgrades: Ancient Invention blueprints (Howl's workshop), Divine Conversion, Inspire Genius

issues.detail: Equilibrium notable combat activities include Temple of Aminishi, Pest Control, Warriors' Guild, Troll Invasion, Taverley Dungeon and Arc Slayer contracts. Catalog content only has GWD1 generals + Nex + Nex AoD + Giant Mole + QBD + Vorago plus smithing/thieving rows.

Bandos equipment, Armadyl equipment, Subjugation equipment, Nex tier-80 armour sets are content kind:upgrade AND folded into upgrades God Wars Dungeon 1 equipment / Nex equipment. Artisans' Workshop burial smithing content duplicates Artisans' Workshop burial equipment hub + Reward Shop upgrades. Safecracking route content overlaps Asgarnia safecracking circuit upgrade.

Many upgrades carry regionId asgarnia but describe foreign hubs or global systems. Examples: Thieves' Guild master thief tools (Lumbridge/Misthalin), Edgeville skilling hub (Misthalin), Death altar Temple of Light (Tirannwn), Ancient Curses / Senntisten (not Asgarnia), Chaeldar (Zanaris/Misthalin), Mazchna/Achtryn (Canifis/Morytania), Morvran (Prifddinas/Tirannwn), Fairy ring network, Orthen furnace core stack (requiredRegions anachronia/tirannwn/forinthry), Area Tasks overview (all diary regions), Aquarium/Prawn Perks multi-portal, Wicked hood multi-region RC tool, Abyssal Link dual-region, GOTE stacks, Crystal tools, etc. Either re-home regionId/regionHints or demote to cross-region only.
evidence: catalog asgarnia.upgrades names after Turael row through end of list

issues.detail: Thieves' Guild master thief tools and Master thief's lockpick + stethoscope rows sit under Asgarnia; Rogues' Den is Asgarnia, but Thieves' Guild is Lumbridge (Misthalin). Catalog Rogues' Den upgrade detail already warns not to treat it as Thieves' Guild.
evidence: asgarnia upgrades: Rogues' Den banking…, Thieves' Guild master thief tools

issues.detail: Four combat gear sets use kind:upgrade inside content[] with confidence unclassified — should live only under upgrades with confirmed_wiki drop mapping (already present on GWD1/Nex upgrade rows).
placeAnchors covers every current catalog area for asgarnia. No orphan anchors. No wrong-region anchors (all region: asgarnia).

If areas add Rimmington, Entrana, Ice Mountain, Goblin Village, The Arc, anchors must be authored and ring-tested. Port Sarim uv [0.425,0.6] may sit slightly far south vs Falador [0.412,0.472] but order is plausible; re-check against BORDER_NODES if map polish pass runs.

Skilling upgrades (Invention Guild machines, Artisans, FPF outfits, Mining Guild, POP/Arc, diaries) are deep; combat content stops at classic Asgarnia bosses and misses League-listed ED1/Pest Control/Warriors' Guild/Taverley Dungeon. Planner will over-weight smithing/invention vs combat unlock narrative.
White Wolf Mountain borders Kandarin; do not add White Wolf Mountain or Catherby-side content to Asgarnia. Burthorpe wiki notes White Wolf Mountain is not classified as Burthorpe starting-zone.
